title: _In vitro_ differentiation of human Th-17 CD4+ T cells
protocol: Isolate mononuclear cells from adult or cord blood on a FicollPAQUE gradient.
Use Miltenyi human CD4+ beads and procedure to isolate CD4+ T cells.
Isolate naive CD4+ T cells by cell sorting. Human naive CD4+ T cells are typically defined as CD3+CD4+CD45RA+CD25-HLA-DR-.
Coat tubes with serum-free media for harvesting cells during sort.
Count cells and resuspend in fresh serum-free media at a concentration of 250,000 to 500,000 cells per mL.
Add 10 U/ml of IL-2, 10 ng/mL of IL-1beta, 10 ng/ml of IL-23, 1 μg/ml of anti-IL-4, 1 μg/mL of anti-IFNgamma and anti-CD3/CD28 activation beads at a ratio of 1 bead per cell.
In U-bottom 96-well plates, aliquot 200 μL per well.
Add an increasing concentration of TGF-beta to a series of four wells: 0, 0.1, 1 and 10 ng/mL.
Spin plates at day 3, remove media and replace with fresh media containing all cytokines and antibodies.
Split each well in half on day 5.
Spin plates on day 5, remove media and replace with fresh media containing all cytokines and antibodies.
Activate cells for 5 hours in the presence of 50 ng/ml PMA and 500 ng/ml ionomycin.
Add 1x BD GolgiStop to the activated cells.
Fix cells in BD Perm/Fix buffer.
Proceed with intracellular staining of IL-17A and IFN-gamma using BD Perm/Wash buffer.
Analyse stained cells by flow cytometry.
